data.one_liner: Use icons from the Iconify.design API in Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides an IconifyIcon widget that loads and renders icons dynamically from the Iconify.design API using a string identifier. It supports caching via shared preferences, custom sizes, colors, placeholders, and error widgets.
use_when: You need to access thousands of icons from multiple icon sets without bloating your asset bundle.
You want a simple widget to fetch and display icons via the Iconify.design API.
avoid_when: Your app must work entirely offline without relying on an external icon API.
You require strict performance guarantees where network requests for icons are unacceptable.
strengths: Grants access to a vast ecosystem of icons via string identifiers.
Allows custom loading placeholders and error widgets.
weaknesses: Depends on network availability to fetch icons from the API.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a robust set of locally bundled Font Awesome icons without requiring external API calls or network access.
